name: zerotierone
description: External dependencies for the ZeroTier One Windows daemon build. opentelemetry-cpp (API only) is provided by scripts/bootstrap-deps.ps1, and inja/cpp-httplib/miniupnpc are fetched by CMake, so they are intentionally not listed here. Only used when configuring with the vcpkg toolchain (the windows-* CMake presets); inert on Linux/macOS.
